incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page: inference-serving-high-error-rate (P1) — 1852345678 — Impact: users seeing 502s on /v1/generate. Paging oncall L2. Docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-502

Manu K.: I’m just finishing handoff, can take driver for the next 30m. Will triage logs and check model variants.

Ashley R.: I’m on comms for the next handoff window if needed, but busy until +25m. If Manu can drive, I’ll prep status for customers.

Jordan L.: quick note — overnight coverage gap 02:00-04:00 UTC shows only one person signed up. We should avoid double-driving during that window. @Priya S. can you confirm coverage?

Priya S.: I can cover 02:00-03:00 UTC but need someone for 03:00-04:00. Noted.

Manu K.: root cause check: load spike + autoscale lag? Running `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --since=10m | grep ERROR | tail -n 50` now. Also seeing elevated 5xx in the LB metrics.

incident-bot: Alert history: 1852345600 - elevated tail latency, 1852345660 - 502 spike. Attached traces: https://observability.internal/trace/abcd1234

Jordan L.: Manu — if autoscaler is slow, consider scaling the replica count manually for the dedicated pool. Runbook step: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-autoscale (see step 3b).

Manu K.: Doing manual scale up now: ```gcloud compute instances resize --zone=us-west1-b rgw-inference-pool --num-replicas=18``` will give headroom. Also toggling fallback routing to model-small for non-SLA traffic.

Ashley R.: Comunications plan: I'll post an initial incident update to #status-pages, tag on small customer list, and update affected endpoints. Draft: "We are observing increased 502s on /v1/generate; mitigation in progress; fallback routing enabled for non-SLA traffic." Approving? :thumbsup:

Jordan L.: :thumbsup: +1. Manu, set `routing.fallback=model-small` in the runtime config and keep me posted.

Manu K.: set fallback, scaled pool to 18 replicas, heat-checking. Error rate dropped from 12% to ~3% in the last 2m. Running health checks.

Priya S.: Thanks Manu. I’ll take primary for 03:00-04:00 UTC — can someone add that to the oncall calendar? We still have a 1h gap at 03:00.

Ben C.: I can cover 03:00-04:00 UTC if Priya needs rest. Adding to calendar now. Also will be backup comms if Ashley needs it.

Ashley R.: Great, thanks Ben. I’ll finish the customer note and hand it off to @Ben C. for the 03:00 update.

Manu K.: Final from me for now — system stable, autoscale responsive after manual bump. Leaving driver to Jordan for follow-up verification and to confirm no regression during scale-down.

Jordan L.: I’m taking driver post-handoff. Comms owner for ongoing updates: Ashley (until 02:30), then Ben (02:30-04:30). Confirmed.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to MONITORED — lead: Jordan L., comms: Ashley R., backup comms: Ben C. — 1852345745

Manu K.: quick runbook pointer for whoever scales back: use the safety-check `curl https://orchestrator.internal/health` and confirm 99th p90 latency under 800ms before reducing replicas.

Priya S.: noted. Closing handoff — thanks everyone.

Ashley R.: Thanks — I’ll post a final status update in 15m unless we see a regression. :white_check_mark:
